title.narrative: Central Asia Regional Economic Coperation Corridor 2 (Bukhara-Miskin-Urgench-Khiva) Railway Electrification Project

description.narrative: The project will add electrification, signaling and telecommunication, and traction power management systems to the recently built railway line between Bukhara, Miskin, Urgench, and Khiva, a total of 465 km. The line has a design speed of 250 km per hour and connects to the electrified high-speed railway line between the country?s capital Tashkent, Samarkand, and Bukhara.

description.narrative: Improved railway services for freight and passengers in Western Uzbekistan

Travel time for freight trains between Bukhara to Urgench reduced to 8.0 hours (2019 baseline: 13.0 hours by diesel train) Achievement: 13 Progress/Status: Achievements will be assessed upon completion. Data Source: UTY annual report

Travel time for passengers between Bukhara to Khiva reduced to 3 hours (2019 baseline: 5.2 hours by diesel train) Achievement: 5.2 Progress/Status: Achievements will be assessed upon completion. Data Source: UTY annual report

Annual freight traffic on the Bukhara to Khiva line increased to 11.8 million tons (2019 baseline: 9.2 million tons) Achievement: 9.2 Progress/Status: Achievements will be assessed upon completion. Data Source: Project completion report

Annual passenger traffic on the Bukhara to Khiva line increased to 1,012,000 passengers (2019 baseline: 280,000 passengers) Achievement: 280000 Progress/Status: Achievements will be assessed upon completion. Data Source: Project completion report Baseline value: 280,000
